title: Custom-axis presentation revision — exact delivery and checks
body:
# CTR52 technical delivery

**Take-home message:** The preferred custom-axis report now omits flag annotations from the second displayed graphic. The scientific content is preserved. [Open the preferred standalone report](/api/attachments/321cc270-6bdd-4484-9bc4-f410a30de469/content).

**Meaningful results:** All six targets, nine bands, both correction curves, all 108 original reflectance values, negative values, missingness and per-panel limits remain. Exactly two figures remain. Figure 1 and all 75 numerical tables are unchanged. The original common-axis report is preserved as a secondary historical alternative. No extraction or statistical analysis was rerun.

**Issues and limitations:** QA fields and scientifically necessary caveats remain in the caption, limitations and supporting tables. This is an author presentation revision; independent scientific review and PI scientific approval have not been granted. The separate [CTR50 workspace/PR prerequisite](/CTR/issues/CTR-50) remains unresolved. No guard was bypassed and no push, PR, merge, publication or manuscript integration occurred.

**Implications and next steps:** This bounded author task is complete. Charles verifies the exact revision below, then routes it through the existing Rachel presentation stage followed by Karl independent scientific review on [CTR38](/CTR/issues/CTR-38). Earlier reviews and the PI's presentation preference do not approve this revision scientifically.

## Exact source and output identity

Final source revision: `f21777bffe1392b0d207b265b852232a779a16f1` on local branch `ctr-49-target-report`. Scientific/presentation baseline: `4e4e46b3b05fb30ef11549c28f5e96e7a40f1bcc`; verified numerical revision: `c4ac607826d6f1c1f3b0ea6040e6a8775ac6bb5b`. Figure/report author revision `5b1b935ea3cd1198c35cf43a3a66e19a3f65f5bd` is followed only by compact-package source and handoff documentation changes in the final revision.

The canonical `report.html`/`report.qmd` are exact copies of `report-custom.html`/`report-custom.qmd`. The preferred download is the compact self-contained HTML, with exactly the same main content and embedded figure bytes. `report-common.qmd`, `report-common.html` and `report-common-portable.html` preserve the original common-axis files byte-for-byte. All former common-axis figure exports remain unchanged.

## Confirmed accessible deliverables

- [Preferred custom-axis report — flag annotations removed](/api/attachments/321cc270-6bdd-4484-9bc4-f410a30de469/content) — 442,240 bytes; SHA-256 `53922889e4ac18c59e9bd69f3ddcac4b54877f74c5fa6ea03e6f568a2f490da0`.
- [Updated six-target spectral figure — 300 dpi PNG](/api/attachments/e0073819-ea98-4f80-8cef-d6e88e0cb6ab/content) — 295,857 bytes; SHA-256 `b393bba4185ddb9527737b97e767d3dc6ae4562b3ec5dc3fa138b01aaec53076`.
- [Updated six-target spectral figure — vector PDF](/api/attachments/a976e99c-5eb2-4482-a658-d1c02c343d58/content) — 30,470 bytes; SHA-256 `d2f9bf13619463bcb1698427984d2c360b482e8e7e8f037a861b84cc46a175b8`.
- [Updated six-target spectral figure — editable SVG](/api/attachments/d6516b78-7246-4afc-946e-ab81e6bab503/content) — 188,182 bytes; SHA-256 `c1301622c27915177d3952359cc5e80315665b00905bd5712057db1df40f687d`.
- [Editable source and validation evidence — compact transfer](/api/attachments/e1180074-f204-481b-b296-1ee0247b5bf9/content) — 263,392 bytes; SHA-256 `bef4a30784cfbec1163dcd219938b921909404f0983fcbc4c676c9a1958ffc8f`.
- [Historical common-axis report — secondary alternative](/api/attachments/cc6d9939-f919-40fd-bb88-bf0716d218a9/content) — 447,523 bytes; SHA-256 `c5a4a0eb94b1f81b14a4f28ba839e6ce8673787f81b9afcba948315d6bfa0359`.
- [Exact revision and validated delivery hashes](/api/attachments/7eb147ce-3803-422e-8f99-7a7097aa15b3/content) — 12,778 bytes; SHA-256 `f3b543699e34b98cfebc8ade157aa1f7a448ff3559af675376ba99ea720a8bf5`.

The preferred report is the primary work product; all other deliverables are secondary. Each item has a confirmed attachment and artifact work product, and the server-returned SHA-256 matches the actual local file. The source ZIP includes editable QMD, R/Python generation/validation scripts, full-precision numerical and QA tables, provenance, environment lockfiles and relevant helpers. It is intended for the existing authorized Git checkout and retained baseline history. The exact Figure 1 SVG is included; unchanged Figure 1 PNG/PDF remain in the full local package and checkout. Raw scientific datasets are excluded.

The first larger 600 dpi PNG transfer returned HTTP 409 and a follow-up attachment listing did not show it; no successful delivery is claimed for that attempt. The confirmed 300 dpi PNG was rasterized directly from the final PDF. The 600 dpi original is preserved locally at `figures/generated/ctr49_target_spectra_custom.png`. The complete source/evidence ZIP and full report ZIP also remain local; the confirmed smaller source package and standalone HTML deliver their intended review materials without a large transfer.

## Preservation and numerical evidence

`provenance/ctr52_before.json` records the live starting state: 546 tracked files and all 74 currently untracked unrelated CTR39 files. The new presentation changes only 12 existing files, preserves the other 534 tracked files, and leaves all 74 unrelated files byte-identical. Subsequent packaging adds only scoped source/handoff updates. Only authorized CTR27 paths were staged; no CTR39 file was staged, stashed, moved or deleted. Raw data, the CTR24 dictionary, final manuscript, root configuration, PI synchronization state and recoverable history are preserved.

`provenance/ctr52_validation.json` (in the source package) records:

- All 75 numerical tables unchanged; exact CTR48 verified hashes checked.
- Custom drawing-row and axis CSVs byte-identical to baseline, including every QA and missingness field.
- Every preferred HTML contains exactly two self-contained images, each matching the exact delivered SVG; Figure 1 matches the baseline.
- The 4322 × 4724 PNG differs only within the removed annotation rectangle, x=2503–3342 and y=625–673. That region is now white; every pixel outside it is identical.
- PDF text extraction retains all six target labels, nine band labels and both correction names, with no flag/cirrus/cloud-probability text in the graphic.
- The thin-cirrus/zero-cloud-probability conflict and unavailable independent ACOLITE mask remain in scientific prose. Other accuracy, spatial-support and independence caveats remain unchanged.

Figure 1 hashes are PNG `87e0fc3f503b326c0db4cbcde7603b81fab888fed64761faac1e24954dc04bad`, PDF `475f6a5f281081cf55bbd437f605e53e17730c8d7d972aa32059e48ae9e3c374`, SVG `952f061328f6ed3b1f280b9a70a6128801e7688384fd75d0fc52103c0e8c3b44`.

## Actual visual inspection and reproducibility

The 600 dpi PNG was opened and all panels A–F inspected. The PDF was independently rasterized with pdftoppm at 140 dpi and that complete image opened. All target and band labels, both curves, retained negative values and the separate-scale warning are readable. The T2 note is absent; no clipping, overlap or missing panels was observed. Dimensions remain 183 × 200 mm with the existing typography.

Both canonical custom HTML and compact standalone HTML were rendered in headless Firefox at 1300 × 4200 and their complete captures opened. Three adjoining compact-report slices were also opened for legible checking of Figure 1, all six spectral panels, captions, the complete six-row table and all limitations/discussion. The canonical table wraps some class names without obscuring values. Screenshots and the detailed author inspection record are committed under `outputs/ctr52_*check.png`, `outputs/ctr52_custom_report_slice*.png` and `provenance/ctr52_visual_inspection.md`. The latter is included in the source package.

Live project instructions were read, origin was fetched, analysis-only readiness returned ready and the existing environment check passed. The preflight refused unrelated untracked CTR39 files and changed nothing; this remains the CTR50 prerequisite. No installation or dependency/lockfile change occurred. The complete corrected presentation builder was rerun successfully, including preservation checks. It reuses the CTR49 safe figure writer and base-R framework, renders only custom outputs through investigation-local Quarto configuration and never renders the manuscript.

Reproduce in the existing authorized checkout using `.venv/bin/python analysis/CTR-27_sen2cor-acolite-asd/scripts/ctr52_delivery.py`, then run `scripts/ctr52_package.py` after the files are committed. Raster QA uses already installed system Python Pillow 10.2.0; no package installation is required. PDF creation metadata may vary without changing figure content. The attachment hash manifest records all final file and package hashes and the exact revision. This document and the committed `CTR52_HANDOFF.md` retain the current caption and provenance route; no review policy was altered.
